name: SAMEBAR -- fleet same-bar re-entry cooldown (core-parity wiring)
commit_discipline: THIS file must be committed BEFORE the wiring commit; verify with git merge-base --is-ancestor <prereg_sha> <wiring_sha>.
classification: core-parity wiring of an ALREADY-SHIPPED guard, not a new edge. The mechanism (exit_actuator.same_bar_cooldown_active / record_entry_bar, EXTRA-SIGNAL-CHURN-COOLDOWN 2026-07-20) has run on the CORE extra-setup lane since 2026-07-20. The fleet entry path never consulted it (verified: callers only heartbeat_core.py:2375/:2410; fleet_live.py references it in a comment only).
rule: Before a fleet arm places a new entry, refuse it if that (arm, setup) already attempted an entry on the SAME closed 5m trigger bar (signal trigger_bar_et string equality, exit_actuator.same_bar_cooldown_active). Stamp (arm, setup, trigger_bar_et) via exit_actuator.record_entry_bar only on an actual placement (placed=true). The trigger bar must ADVANCE before the same setup re-enters. No numeric knob exists -- structural, same as core.
fail_open_contract: A cooldown-file read error, a missing/None trigger_bar_et on the signal, or ANY exception in the consult must never block an entry (mirrors core's try/except + same_bar_cooldown_active's own fail-open). A record failure must never abort an already-placed entry.

metrics: counterfactual P&L of blocked legs on real fills

kill_criteria: any single session where the cooldown blocks an entry that would have been a winner > +$150 (real-fills counterfactual)
2 consecutive weeks net-negative attributable to the cooldown
revert_one_line: automation/state/fleet/fleet_live.py: set FLEET_SAME_BAR_COOLDOWN = False (single flag; consult + stamp both gate on it)
guards: automation/state/fleet/test_fleet_same_bar_cooldown.py (vary-and-assert: same trigger bar -> second entry blocked; NEW trigger bar -> allowed; fail-open on cooldown error; no stamp on refused placement)
